Exact line profiles use independently derived area 23/3 and volume 46/3 with rational holes and translation by 10^400. The original strict involute/cycloidal gear catalog is retained. Integer bindings retain 2^53+1; WASM translates a unit square by 2^53 and its extruded solid back. Other profile representations retain the pre-existing finite path and its open fidelity/provenance limitation.
